name: L1 + LPIPS + Log-Spectral + Phase
tagline: L1 + multi-scale L1 + LPIPS@2.0 + sqrt-frequency-weighted log-amplitude FFT loss + small phase-aware FFT term + KL.
formula:
$$ \mathcal{L} = \|x-\hat x\|_1 + \lambda_{ms}\|\downarrow_2 x - \downarrow_2 \hat x\|_1 + \lambda_p\,\text{LPIPS}(x,\hat x) + \lambda_{kl}\,D_{\text{KL}} $$
$$ + \lambda_s\Big(\sum w(f)\,\big|\log(1+|F\hat x|) - \log(1+|Fx|)\big| + 0.05\big(\|\Re F\hat x - \Re Fx\|_1 + \|\Im F\hat x - \Im Fx\|_1\big)\Big) $$
$$ w(f) = 1 + 4\sqrt{\|f\|_2} $$

key_hyperparams.name: phase_weight
key_hyperparams.role: scaling of real+imag L1 within spectral term

init_recovers: perceptual baseline at perceptual_weight=0.5 with extra terms zeroed
diff_from_baseline: Adds three terms on top of L1+LPIPS+KL: a half-resolution L1 (ms_loss), a sqrt-frequency-weighted log-amplitude FFT loss, and a small real/imaginary L1 phase term, while quadrupling the LPIPS weight to 2.0.

name: L1 + LPIPS + Hinge GAN + Feature Match
tagline: Identical to the vqgan baseline: L1 + LPIPS + KL plus a spectral-norm PatchGAN discriminator with feature-matching loss after step 5000.

key_hyperparams.name: disc_start
key_hyperparams.role: step at which GAN turns on

key_hyperparams.name: gp_weight
key_hyperparams.role: R1 gradient-penalty coefficient (added by training loop)

init_recovers: perceptual baseline before disc_start; vqgan baseline thereafter
diff_from_baseline: Effectively the same loss class as the vqgan baseline (spectral-norm PatchGAN, hinge loss, feature-matching coefficient 1.0, disc_start=5000) — no novel modifications to the vqgan recipe.

name: Low-pass + 16-ring Spectrum + LPIPS
tagline: L1 + LPIPS + KL combined with a low-pass-filtered pixel L1 and a 16-ring radially-binned amplitude-spectrum L1 (high rings up-weighted).
formula:
$$ M_{LF}(r) = \exp(-r^2/0.1), \quad B_i = \{(u,v): \lfloor r(u,v)\cdot 16 \rfloor = i\}, \quad w_i = 1+\tfrac{i}{16} $$
$$ \mathcal{L} = 0.5\|x-\hat x\|_1 + \|F^{-1}(M_{LF}\,F\hat x) - F^{-1}(M_{LF}\,Fx)\|_1 + 2\sum_i w_i\big|\overline{|F\hat x|}_{B_i} - \overline{|Fx|}_{B_i}\big| + \lambda_p\text{LPIPS} + \lambda_{kl}D_{\text{KL}} $$
diff_from_baseline: Adds two FFT-domain terms to the perceptual baseline: an L1 between Gaussian-low-pass-filtered images and a 16-ring radial-mean amplitude-spectrum L1 with linearly increasing per-ring weights; pixel L1 weight is halved to 0.5.

name: Phase-aware Spectrum + HF Balance + Var Anchor
tagline: Curriculum spectral loss on log-compressed amplitudes plus a low/high-band balance term and a posterior log-variance anchor.
formula:
$$ p(t) = \min(t/5000, 1), \quad \rho = \sqrt{u^2+v^2}, \quad A_x = \overline{|Fx|}_C $$
$$ \mathcal{L}_{\text{fft}} = \overline{(0.8 + \rho(0.5+1.0\,p(t)))\,\big|\log(1+6 A_{\hat x}) - \log(1+6 A_x)\big|} $$
$$ \mathcal{L}_{\text{HF}} = \overline{\mathrm{ReLU}\big(\overline{e}_{\rho>0.45} - (0.9-0.3 p(t))\,\overline{e}_{\rho\leq 0.45}\big)},\;\; \mathcal{L}_{\text{var}} = (\overline{\log\sigma^2} + 0.2)^2 $$
$$ \mathcal{L} = \|x-\hat x\|_1 + 0.6\,\text{LPIPS} + 10^{-6} D_{\text{KL}} + 0.06\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{fft}} + 0.03\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{HF}} + 10^{-4}\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{var}} $$

key_hyperparams.name: ring_split
key_hyperparams.role: low/high band threshold on normalized radial freq

init_recovers: perceptual baseline before step 0 (FFT/var terms small)
diff_from_baseline: On top of L1+LPIPS+KL adds (a) a curriculum-weighted log-amplitude spectrum L1 with high-frequency emphasis growing over 5k steps, (b) a ReLU 'high should not exceed (0.9 - 0.3p)*low' band-balance term, and (c) a quadratic anchor pulling the posterior mean log-variance toward -0.2.

name: Freq-weighted L2 + HP Gradient + MS-SSIM
tagline: L1 + LPIPS + KL augmented with frequency-weighted FFT residual L1, high-pass gradient matching, and 2-scale SSIM.
formula:
$$ M_{HP}(r)=\tfrac{1}{1+(0.35/r)^4},\;\; W(r)=1+2r,\;\; \mathcal{L}_{\text{fw}}=\overline{|F(\hat x - x)|\cdot W} $$
$$ \mathcal{L}_{\text{grad}} = \big\| |\nabla F^{-1}(M_{HP}F\hat x)| - |\nabla F^{-1}(M_{HP}Fx)| \big\|_1 $$
$$ \mathcal{L} = \|x-\hat x\|_1 + 0.5\,\text{LPIPS} + 0.1\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{fw}} + 0.2\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{grad}} + 0.2\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{SSIM}}^{(11)} + 0.05\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{SSIM}}^{(7,\downarrow_2)} + 10^{-6} D_{\text{KL}} $$

key_hyperparams.name: high_cutoff
key_hyperparams.role: Butterworth-style high-pass cutoff on normalized radius

key_hyperparams.name: low_cutoff
key_hyperparams.role: low-pass cutoff (mask precomputed but unused in final loss)

key_hyperparams.name: freq_weight_slope
key_hyperparams.role: linear ramp on radial weight W(r)=1+2r

init_recovers: perceptual baseline when freq, grad and SSIM weights are zero
diff_from_baseline: Beyond L1+LPIPS+KL it adds a frequency-radial-weighted FFT residual L1, an L1 between gradient magnitudes of high-pass-filtered images, and an MS-SSIM term at full and half resolution.
